Allah Hafiz. Question: Assalam O' Alaikum. We are having baby boy and want to know if these names are appropriate: Mikail - One of Allah's Angels Ayaan - God's Gift Zariyaan - King of Kings Sulaiman - Prophet's Name Are these names permissible and if they're not, please share the reasoning. Allah Hafiz. Answer ID: 13090 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1274/1003=H/1430) You can name him Mikail , but it is better to choose any name like Abdullah, Abdur Rahman, Abdul Qadir, Saad, Sayeed, Abu Ubaidah etc. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
